name: io.github.acuris-gmbh/acuris-mcp
description: Acuris address validation & geocoding: 240+ countries, Royal Mail PAF (UK, UDPRN+UPRN), free US/Canada census enrichment (FIPS, tract, CBSA, districts). Honest verified/corrected verdicts; failed lookups auto-refunded.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your Acuris API key> — get a free trial key via the request_trial_key tool or https://www.acuris-geo.com/acuris-pricing/

environmentVariables.name: ACURIS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Acuris API key (free trial: request_trial_key tool)
